name: logichain-platform
description: Mono-repo LogiChain — API Node.js/Express (backend), application mobile React Native (frontend) et infrastructure Ansible (infra).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

comment: Ce manifeste n'a AUCUNE dependance : il ne sert qu'a orchestrer les sous-projets. Toute dependance applicative appartient a backend/package.json ou frontend/package.json (cf. docs/adr/ADR-001-monorepo.md).
